{{Youmay|a mineral|[[Desh (Imperial)]]}}
'''Desh''' was a very flexible, but less sturdy, naturally occurring metallic element used to protect [[Droid/Legends|droids]] during the centuries surrounding the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and the [[Jedi Civil War|War of the Star Forge]].

When combined with another type of alloy, desh armor plating became a very cost-effective means of shielding droids from external damage; [[maranium]] was often one such recombinant that cut the weight and expense, but at the cost to the overall durability.

When combined with [[terenthium]], it produced a super-light alloy which was used by [[OmoTact Corporation]] to manufacture [[skyship]]s like the [[Roahks 7m Skyship]].<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref>
